Designing the App's Features and Functionality

When designing a scheduling app for notaries, there are several key features to consider. These include:

  • Client management: enabling notaries to store client information and track their appointment history
  • Reminders and notifications: sending automatic reminders and notifications to clients and notaries
  • Payment processing: integrating payment gateways to facilitate secure and easy payments
